quotes: Your individuality is something worth appreciating.
There is something lovely about the way you carry yourself.
You deserve good things, calm days, and genuine happiness.
Never underestimate the quiet impact of being yourself.
Your smile can make an ordinary moment feel a little brighter.
Keep growing at your own pace. You are doing just fine.
The little things that make you different are worth celebrating.
You do not have to be perfect to be wonderful.

copy.welcomeEyebrow: A LITTLE SOMETHING, JUST FOR YOU
copy.welcomeDescription: A small collection of lovely moments, kind thoughts, and a little appreciation.
copy.heroEyebrow: A LITTLE PAGE, MADE WITH APPRECIATION
copy.heroTitle: Some people make\nordinary days feel\na little brighter.
copy.heroDescription: This is a tiny corner of the internet to celebrate the lovely things that make you, you. No big occasion needed.
copy.galleryDescription: Different looks, different moods — one little collection made to feel warm, thoughtful, and full of colour.
copy.galleryNote: A CREATIVE COLLECTION · ORIGINAL PHOTO IS IDENTIFIED SEPARATELY
copy.appreciationTitle: Never forget how lovely\nit is to be you.
copy.complimentFallback: Tap below for a little reminder you deserve to hear.
copy.pollTitle: Which style do you like most?
copy.pollDescription: Pick a favourite if you feel like it. Your choice is counted only if you opted into anonymous analytics.
copy.keepsakeDescription: A couple of creative poster-style keepsakes from the collection. A little colour, a little nostalgia, and a lot of care.
copy.letterDescription: Not a big speech. Just a few genuine words, wrapped up with care.
copy.letterParagraphOne: I wanted to make something a little different instead of sending an ordinary message.
copy.letterParagraphTwo: This is simply a small way of appreciating you. Your individuality and the little things that make you who you are deserve to be celebrated.
copy.letterParagraphThree: I hope this little surprise brings a smile to your face. Keep being yourself, keep growing, and never forget that you deserve kindness and happiness.
copy.letterSignature: someone who thinks you're pretty wonderful.
copy.feedbackPrompt: Before you go, how did this little page feel?
copy.feedbackDisclaimer: Optional · No message or personal details are collected.
copy.footerEyebrow: A LITTLE REMINDER TO TAKE WITH YOU
copy.footerDescription: Wishing you more reasons to smile, more moments to cherish, and all the good things you deserve.
